Essentia: LogAttackTime reads the output of Envelope and returns the attack's start and stop times. Its classifiers on Discogs-EffNet embeddings include timbre-discogs-effnet (bright or dark), nsynth_bright_dark, nsynth_acoustic_electronic, nsynth_reverb (dry or wet), nsynth_instrument (with synth_lead and bass classes), mtg_jamendo_instrument (40 classes, including synthesizer and pad), the mood models and genre_discogs400. The models are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and were trained on music recordings, so they judge a clip's overall character.
